entities.summary: Elisabeth Rosenthal is an American physician and former New York Times reporter who focused on health and environment matters. She is the author of a 2017 book, An American Sickness, which argues that severely distorted financial incentives are at the root of the US healthcare problems. She continues to contribute to the New York Times in the 'Opinion' section.
